newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau's BCM-Asia says nets 81 mln patacas in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Macau's BCM-Asia says nets 81 mln patacas in 1996.

text.p: Banco Comercial de Macau-Asia said on Wednesday it had net profit of 81 million patacas in 1996.
A spokesman for the bank, Renato Feitor, said he was unable to give a year-on-year comparative figure, since the bank was incorporated in Macau only in September 1995.
Feitor said 32.4 million patacas would be used for dividends, corresponding to 36 patacas per share.
Some 29 million patacas were earmarked for the bank's free reserves, apart from 16.2 million patacas put aside for legal reserves, he said.
The bank's own funds had risen to 369 million patacas following the results, he said.

Board member Rui Barata said BCM-Asia was planning to open a representative office in Guangzhou in southern China. The bank may also find a Chinese partner to make possible the set up of a joint venture bank in China, he said.
The bank named as its chairman Jorge Jardim Goncalves, who is also chairman of Banco Comercial Portugues and Banco Portugues do Atlantico in Portugal.
